source01: Create ONE clean reusable 9-slice pixel-art paper card source for a modern magical academy game. Perfect front view, square, no perspective. Exact tiny 32x32 logical-pixel design magnified on one single regular square macro-pixel grid (~32 output pixels per logical pixel). A square ivory paper rectangle, intact simple square corners, true transparent empty margin outside. ALL interior is ONE completely flat neutral warm ivory color. Border is ONLY ONE continuous logical pixel of a single muted medium taupe color on all four sides. Maximum THREE opaque colors total. NO bevel, NO highlight stripe, NO gold, NO leather, NO weathering, NO dots, NO tears, NO chips, NO dark black rim, NO texture, NO gradient, NO shadow, NO lighting, NO ornaments. Native subject about 28x28 logical pixels centered with about two logical pixels safe margin. Entire outline precisely straight, consistent width, no broken corners. Large aligned square macro-pixels with no subpixel details, no smoothing, no antialiasing, no dithering. Complete paper-filled rectangle, not hollow frame. One asset only on transparency.

Native lattice correction: use exactly equal 32-output-pixel squares, including the full outline and transparent silhouette. Keep the uniform interior and the single muted outline, no fine shading.
